capabilities: Move the cursor one word at a time with standard word shortcuts
Select and delete by word (backwards and forwards) in spaceless scripts
Select a single word via double-click or double-tap
Apply word navigation across multiple cursors
Leave space-separated languages such as English unchanged
disambiguation: Not a text-analysis or NLP tool; it only changes how the editor cursor moves, selects, and deletes by word.
extras: README links out to separate docs on architecture, contributing, and releasing; listed as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Obsidian’s default editor treats a whole sentence as one word. This plugin uses the browser’s built-in word segmenter
problem: In scripts without spaces, Obsidian's default editor treats a whole sentence as one word, so word shortcuts and double-click selection skip entire sentences.
summary: Editor plugin that makes word-wise move, select, and delete shortcuts work per word in spaceless scripts like Chinese, Japanese, and Thai.
